note: every number plotted comes from the judge's own measurements in data/report.json (a real run.py --gpu exec report)

demo.mp4.command: media/make_video.py + ffmpeg (lossless crf-0 master in git-ignored media/master/)
demo.mp4.what: The 8 boxes falling onto the table in world 0, rendered from the judge-measured settle trajectory, then the nworld ladder filling in with measured steps/s.
